overview.description: The Tortoise Energy ETF (TNGY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is actively managed, investing globally in both equity and debt securities across the full energy sector. The fund seeks current income and, secondarily, long-term capital appreciation. TNGY was launched on Jun 16, 2025 and is issued by Tortoise.
